claim: For each fixed compact connected simple G, Peter-Weyl matrix coefficients are dense in L2(G).
The bi-invariant Laplacian on compact connected G has discrete spectrum and constants are its zero eigenspace, hence c_G=lambda_1(-Delta_G)>0.
The heat kernel K_t has the character expansion sum_R d_R exp(-t C2(R)) chi_R and is a positive convolution semigroup.
Pure Yang-Mills has one-loop b0(G)=11 C_A/(48 pi^2)>0.

Therefore the regulator, heat-kernel/reflection-positive, Peter-Weyl, and AF-summability portions of the construction are group-parametric; no uniform constant across all simple groups is required by the quantifier any G.
remaining_group_dependence: Only master estimates M1(G) and M2(G) require group-dependent constants; JW-13 is not an independent theorem gate.
